{{Quote|Juggernaut One has been hit. Cam out; telemetry data... it's still moving, but just barely. Another hit like that and it'll be as dead in the mud as Juggernaut Nine.|General Tasse, to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Tasse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the military of the [[Empire of the Hand]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Tasse co-ordinated the movements of Imperial [[juggernaut]]s during an Empire of the Hand [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
